title: roscoea lutea
intro: Roscoea lutea, commonly known as yellow roscoea, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the ginger family (Zingiberaceae). It is native to the Himalayan region and is traditionally used in Ayurvedic and Unani medicine for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Roscoea lutea include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic actions, and its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
